messages:
Jordan T: Hi all -- first day! I need Datadog + Sentry access for my service (team-inventory). Also want to set up a monitor for p95 latency and hook alerts to #infra-alerts. Who do I ping?
Priya: Welcome Jordan! For Datadog/Sentry we use the obs-access form: https://forms.redwood.com/obs-access. Select 'Datadog - write' and 'Sentry - project member' and list the project slugs ('team-inventory').
Jordan T: There's an option for 'API key' vs 'app key' — what's recommended for monitor creation?
SRE-Kim: For infra changes and monitors create an app key under your account if you need automation; API keys are org-level and we avoid sharing them. If you only need to click-create monitors from the UI, 'Datadog - write' is enough. For Terraform or CI automation, request a machine app key and we'll put it in Vault.
Oncall-Matt: Also decide monitor type. For p95 latency use an APM/trace percentile monitor with query like:
```
avg(last_5m):percentile(avg:trace.http.request.duration{env:prod,service:team-inventory},95)>200
```
and set notify: @pagerduty(infra) for Sev1 or #infra-alerts for warnings.
Jordan T: Cool. I filled the form with 'team-inventory', monitor intent, and tagged @Priya. Submitted a screenshot of the 403 when trying to create the monitor.
Devex-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/datadog#monitors and https://docs.redwood.com/observability/sentry#projects. Include exact monitor query and the alert channel in the form to speed approval.
Priya: If you need Sentry alert rules, request the 'alerts-editor' role for the project. Add the rule name and Slack channel mapping. We keep channel mappings in the runbook.
Jordan T: One more Q: how do I map Sentry issues to a GitHub issue automatically?
SRE-Kim: We use the Sentry->GitHub integration: Sentry Settings -> Integrations -> GitHub -> enable 'Create Issue' for the repo. If you don't have org install perms, open an #ops-requests ticket and tag @SRE-Kim.
Docs-bot: Quick runbook: https://docs.redwood.com/observability/runbooks/alerting. Naming conventions: team-service-event (e.g., inventory-api-p95), include severity tag, and set escalation policy.
Jordan T: Thanks all. Priya 1F44B the form is pending; can you nudge approval?
Priya: On it. I'll ping your manager and approve the write scopes. Expect propagation in ~2 minutes after Okta approval.
Jordan T: Re-logged after 2 minutes and I can create a monitor in Datadog dev. Will not touch prod without SRE review. Appreciate the help! :raised_hands:
